newPatient.title: Kyerɛw ɔyarefoɔ din
newPatient.consentText: Kyerɛ ɔyarefoɔ no wɔ ne kasa mu nea enti a wokora ne nsɛm, na ka kyerɛ no sɛ ɔbɛtumi apo.
newPatient.consentMethod: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔpenee so?
newPatient.consentGiven: Ɔyarefoɔ no apene so sɛ wɔnkora n'apɔmuden nsɛm.
newPatient.consentPromise: Ne nsɛm bɛtena fon yi so kɔsi sɛ wɔde bɛkɔ apɔmuden dwumadie no hɔ wɔ ahobammɔ mu. Ne apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ nko ara na wɔbɛhunu.
newPatient.personText: Kyerɛw nea ɔyarefoɔ no ka kyerɛ wo. Sɛ onnim n'awoda a, kyerɛw ne mfeɛ.
newPatient.placeText: Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ ne ayaresabea a ɛfata bɛtumi ahwɛ no.
newPatient.phoneWhy: Ɛho nhia. Ɛyɛ nsrahwɛ nkaeɛ nko ara.
newPatient.nationalIdWhy: Ɛho nhia. Ɛyɛ NHIS nhwehwɛmu nko ara.
newPatient.statement: Yɛpɛ sɛ yɛkora wo apɔwmuden ho nsɛm wɔ fon yi so, na yɛde kɔma Ghana Health Service wɔ ɔkwan a ɛho tɔ so so, sɛnea wo apɔwmuden adwumayɛfoɔ bɛtumi ahwɛ wo yie. Wo apɔwmuden adwumayɛfoɔ nko ara na wɔbɛhunu. Wobɛtumi aka sɛ dabi, na wobɛtumi aka akyerɛ yɛn sɛ yɛnnyae bere biara. Wopene so?

surveillance.partial: Nnawɔtwe bi wɔ hɔ a ayarefoɔ nnu 5, enti yɛnkan wɔn, sɛnea ɛbɛbɔ wɔn ho ban.

surveillance.privacy: Yɛde akontabuo a ɛsua sene 5 sie sɛnea obiara rentumi nhunu ɔyarefoɔ biara (Act 843 s.24(3)).
surveillance.signalText: Ayarefoɔ {{now}} na na wɔwɔ atiridiiɛ nnawɔtwe a atwam no, nanso na ɛyɛ {{avg}} wɔ nnawɔtwe 4 a ɛdi kan no mu. Bisa mansin kuo no.
